ink.$description: Ink — Body text, headings, primary borders, icon strokes — the dominant neutral that carries almost all type and structural lines

cream-canvas.$description: Cream Canvas — Page background and deepest warm surface — the base tone of the entire site

warm-white.$description: Warm White — Primary card and section surface, nav background, soft fills

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Button hover surfaces and elevated neutral blocks, slightly cooler than Warm White

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Top-level product card surfaces and modal panels that need to float above cream

sand-border.$description: Sand Border — Subtle warm-gray dividers and disabled controls

stone-text.$description: Stone Text — Secondary and helper text, muted labels, description copy

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Pure black for SVG icon fills in dark contexts only

terracotta.$description: Terracotta — Primary action button fill, the one chromatic accent — warm orange against cream creates urgency without aggression

archivo.$description: Single typeface system. Weight 400 carries body, captions, and descriptions; weight 600 is reserved for headings, nav items, and button labels. Archivo's geometric warmth matches the cream palette — its straight-sided 'A' and open apertures read as set type, not screen type.
